error[ZBX-E0311]: --ulimit is above your own hard limit
  cause  --ulimit memlock asks for a hard limit of 67108864, above your own,
         8388608; a rootless run can't raise it
  fix    raise it for logins (then log in again):                              echo "$(id -un) hard memlock 65536" | sudo tee -a /etc/security/limits.conf
         or for the user manager, add LimitMEMLOCK=67108864 under [Service]:   sudo systemctl edit user@1000.service
  more   zbx explain E0311 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0311.html
